name: Spellsword
body:
Sometimes a sword is not enough to protect and serve.

The spellsword weaves magic in with swordplay and their armor to turn themselves into an arcane bulwark against the tide of their enemies.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

Spellswords are proficient only with light and medium armor and shields, except tower shields. This alters the vanguard’s normal armor proficiencies.

Class Skills: Spellswords add Knowledge (arcana) and Spellcraft to their list of class skills. This alters the vanguard’s class skills.

Arcane Mettle (Su)

The spellsword gains the following new uses for Mettle:

As part of casting a spell the spellsword may expend a point of Mettle to increase the save DC of a spell they cast by +1. At 5th level this bonus improves by an additional +1 plus one at 10th, 15th and 20th level. The bonus provided stacks with other feats or abilities that increase the DCs of spells.

At 6th level, the spellsword may expend points of Mettle to pay for the increased level of spells to which you apply the Silent Spell, Still Spell, Enlarge Spell, and Extend Spell metamagic feats. Rather than using a higher level spell slot to cast these spells the spell sword may spend a number of points of Mettle equal to the number of spell slots the metamagic feat would increase the spell being cast. The spellsword may only use this ability once per round and only with the available metamagic feats and only on spells up to one level below the maximum spell level they are capable of casting.

At 10th Level, they may use this ability with Authoritative Spell, Empower Spell, Intensified Spell, Thundering Spell, and Sickening Spell. At 14th level, they may use this ability with Maximize Spell. Finally, at 20th level, they may use this ability with Quicken Spell.

This ability modifies mettle.

Spell Combat (Su)

At 1st level, the spellsword gains spell combat as the magus ability of the same name.

Additionally they gain Eschew Materials as a bonus feat.

This ability replaces weapons of the guardian.

Combat Casting

At 2nd level, the spellsword gains Combat Casting as a bonus feat. The bonus granted by Combat Casting improves by +1 every 6 levels thereafter to a maximum of +4 at 20th level.

This ability replaces shield focus.

Bonus Metamagic

At 6th level and every 4 levels thereafter, the spellsword gains a bonus metamagic or item creation feat.

This ability replaces bonus combat feats.

Forceful Spells (Ex)

At 8th level, a spellsword may add their strength bonus to the hit point damage dealt by spells that require a melee attack roll (including melee touch attacks) and may also apply the effects of Power Attack to those spells. This damage is of the same type dealt by the spell.

This ability replaces brace.

Spellcasting

A spellsword casts spells from the magus spell list. A spellsword uses Charisma to determine the saving throws of spells they cast and to determine bonus spells per day. The spellsword learns, prepares and casts spells like a wizard. Their daily spell allotment is given on the table on page 15.

On levels where they have ‘0’ spells, they only gain bonus spells per day granted by their ability score.

Unlike many arcane spellcasters a spellsword suffers no arcane spell failure when casting spellsword spells in light or medium armor or while wearing a buckler of light shield. The somatic components for spellsword spells can be performed while wielding a weapon, they consist of arcs and flourishes that complement the the martial arts.

This ability replaces trial by combat, armor training, bulwark, and second skin.
